title: Page 110
transc:
SH Beckwith  Washn July 15th 1864
Julia Kimball Crowd stop Waltzer McClellan from Ginger with 
Edwards Douglas Perkins summer Morgan pelton arrived here Topsy
yard A warsaw agent who left Sandy Hook this
morning watsons Meridens sable began to reach Churn Yancey
evening and were till this morning pocketing wafer to
Pleasant wreathe although foot sore and badly used up
tulip Allen wayne remains at Florida & a quickenment
at Duffield stick Augusta is with the main laugh
stop A signal radical at trinity of Rocks says
robin pocketed large wagon whig at Nolans salmon yesterday
morning rewarded by the regret of their pekin &
sugar yard Another signal radical at Sugar loaf steuben
says they pocketed Andrew Smith wagons at white ford
austin sylvan below mouth of Monocacy yesterday morning swindling
in direction of Snickers shannon yacht They were still
pluming at Fanny according to this radical yacht Cupid
thinks the main haunt have gone through Snickers &
but a small portion through Ashby shannon stop Lady
estimates the sable they have had before Hang at
Nelson Edwards Dwight to Norris zebra as follows Earlys
pelham Austin queens spike Kidnap Gordons & Ramsers Gilbert
Donaldson stop Ingots pelton Arnold quaker Gilbert seward stop
pedlar & Pagan Baker sprague to clarke zebra with
Ogden cannon tulip Comet thinks they have got Caldwell
or Clarke zebra excellent silvers and Brooks Dwight poor
